11-2D-4. - Standards in the old town district (O-T).
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT11UNDECO_CH2DIRE_ARTDTRNEDI_11-2D-4STOLTODI","Title":"11-2D-4. - Standards in the old town district (O-T).","Content":"
\n

\n The standards for development in the Old Town District are set forth in this section\n as follows:\n \n

\n A.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Building height. In the area defined as the city core in chapter 1, any new construction shall have\n a minimum height of thirty-five (35) feet and a maximum height of one hundred (100)\n feet. All other areas in the district, the maximum building height is seventy-five\n (75) feet.\n

\n \t\t\n \n

\n B.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Number of stories. Minimum number of stories for new construction is two (2) and/or as set forth in\n the \"City of Meridian Architectural Standards Manual\".\n

\n \t\t\n \n

\n C.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Streetscape improvements. Streetscape improvements within the city core shall be designed in accord with the\n \"City of Meridian Public Works Design Standards Manual\".\n

\n \t\t\n \n

\n D.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Residential to commercial conversions. Residential to commercial conversions within old town shall comply with the established\n standards set forth in the \"Architectural Standards Manual\" (ASM) and structure and\n site design standards set forth in Section 11-3A-19 of this title. Where there are site constraints that prevent a conversion from wholly\n complying with these standards, the applicant may submit for a design standard exception\n as set forth in the ASM.\n

\n \t\t\n \n

\n E.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Public and other urban open spaces. When proposed as part of a development, public and other urban open spaces shall\n have sufficient pedestrian access and be integrated into the overall site design.\n

\n \t\t\n \n

\n (Ord. 05-1170, 8-30-2005, eff. 9-15-2005; Ord. 16-1672, 2-16-2016; Ord. 16-1717, 1-3-2017;\n Ord. No. 21-1932, § 2, 6-15-2021)\n
